artifactLines: Spring — soft damping, the settle is the character.
Overshoot — over-corrects; that is the design.
Draw-on stroke — terracotta path, fill follows.
Mask + iris — wipe then radial open.

yourTurn.command: Animate my initials mark with a spring entrance, then show the same entrance as a draw-on stroke — and tell me which feels authored and which feels generated.
